description: This file implements the ControlIpc class and related factory functions for inter-process communication (IPC) in the Rialto client, handling shared memory, client registration, and event subscriptions.

classes.name: ControlIpcFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating ControlIpc objects.

classes.name: ControlIpc
classes.description: Implements IPC communication for control messages, including shared memory management, client registration, and event handling.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new ControlIpcFactory instance.

methods.name: getControlIpc
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a ControlIpc instance associated with the provided control client.

methods.name: ControlIpc
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ControlIpc object with control client, IPC client, and event thread factory.

methods.name: ~ControlIpc
methods.description: Destructor that detaches the IPC channel and resets the event thread.

methods.name: getSharedMemory
methods.description: Requests shared memory from the IPC server, returning file descriptor and size.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers the client with the IPC server and stores the control handle.

methods.name: createRpcStubs
methods.description: Creates RPC stubs for IPC communication.

methods.name: subscribeToEvents
methods.description: Subscribes to application state change and ping events over IPC.

methods.name: onApplicationStateUpdated
methods.description: Handles application state change events and notifies the control client.

methods.name: onPing
methods.description: Handles ping events, sends acknowledgment if the handle matches.
